diagnostics.qualification: Out-of-spec diagnostic: XLA split tied input/output weights, yielding 24,257,505 parameters and 111 optimizer entries. Preserve raw reports, but do not treat their 15m scope label as an accurate parameter count.
diagnostics.rng_failure: An RNG getter synchronized XLA and advanced the seed; observed seed 15320202538237034168 became 6390896005953414023 after sync. Fixed snapshot reads and checkpoint synchronization preserve the next-step seed.
